summary: The Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee met on February 3, 2009 to discuss prasugrel's bleeding risk, an unexpected excess of malignancies, and a salt-to-base product-quality issue, and recommended approval by a 9 to 0 vote. Although initially the Division had planned to forego an AdComm, the Office convened one for these complex issues. The committee's main documented influence was on the cancer signal: it was skeptical of the finding and urged that it be described in the Adverse Reactions section rather than Warnings/Precautions, which is where FDA placed it, while a post-marketing requirement to collect cancer data in the TRILOGY trial was also adopted.
